subject: M00-T05-review3-go: independent adversarial review of the Go + Bubble Tea G02 prototype after round 3b (prototypes/go, working tree a04f2f3+dirty, source digest list review3/source-tree-sha256.txt sha256 f79cd6e3c346f1cbb90ea34c519b681b56eae6d4c04763287f022b7e8be5162b; artifacts darwin-arm64 a5644a4f5c18cc70fdeaa0b83ac9cc50557449f05809246cc5813af42e685310, linux-arm64 efd3ee08d591fd9dd6d4111fba21b6f8a0c3fe62d6d49d96ff9d8308b0851c04)

defects.location: internal/run/run.go Run (exec.Command with nil Env) -> Go runtime syscall.copyenv/os.Environ; evidence review3/probes/env-fd-darwin.json, probes/linux/env-fd-linux.json
defects.description: `run` does not pass the raw environment block through like exec(2): with a raw envp [.., DUPKEY=first, NOEQUALS_ENTRY, EMPTY=, DUPKEY=last, ..] the child of heimdall-proto sees DUPKEY=first only, while the control (same envp to /usr/bin/env) sees both entries. The Go runtime clears later duplicate keys at start-up. Observed identically on darwin-arm64 and linux-arm64. Entries without '=' and empty values pass. First-wins matches libc getenv, so this is a transparency deviation, not an obvious hazard, but it is not disclosed in REPORT.md (§4 says the child inherits the environment).

defects.location: internal/run/run_unix.go (forwarded = INT/TERM/HUP/QUIT/WINCH; no handling of a stop of heimdall-proto itself); evidence review3/probes/sigjob-darwin.json, probes/linux/sigjob-linux.json scenario 'tstp'
defects.description: An explicit `kill -TSTP <heimdall-proto pid>` in modeExclusive stops heimdall-proto only. bash, zsh and dash all report the job stopped, but the child keeps running (10 heartbeats per second, state S) until `fg`. In the control (same command without heimdall-proto) the child stops (0 heartbeats, state T). Observed on darwin-arm64 and linux-arm64 under all three shells. By code the same holds for SIGSTOP. §9.3 lists signals beyond the five forwarded ones as recorded for ADR-0002, not gated, so this is non-gating. It is the inverse of K6e's rule (job believed stopped while the child runs) and is not mentioned in REPORT.md.

defects.location: tests/g02/conformance.py harness.signal_duplicate_probe -> observations.signal_duplicates; the round-3b stage summary supplied with this task
defects.description: Evidence interpretation. The stage summary says terminal-generated SIGINT 'was delivered twice in 4/10 trials on darwin and 0/10 on linux'. That observation is the harness's own observability probe: a Python wrapper that calls kill() twice back to back. It does not involve heimdall-proto or a terminal. Its real meaning: Linux merged the back-to-back pair in 10/10 trials (0/10 again in my run), darwin in 4/10 (6/10 in mine). So on Linux the harness's exactly-once gates cannot detect a back-to-back double forward. For Go this is covered by code (one cmd.Process.Signal per receipt) and by my probes, which see separated kernel-plus-forward duplicates as 2. Do not cite that number as heimdall-proto behavior in the ADR.

defects.location: prototypes/go working tree (git status: run_unix.go, main.go, helper_test.go, REPORT.md modified; k6d_test.go, tui_terminfo_test.go untracked); .gitignore excludes prototypes/*/dist/ and prototypes/go/bin/
defects.description: Traceability. The measured round-3b source exists only as uncommitted changes, and the records carry build_commit a04f2f3...+dirty. plan.md §3 G02 requires prototype commit IDs in the ADR. The working tree at review time rebuilds to the recorded digests, which I verified for all four targets. The source digest list is in review3/source-tree-sha256.txt. Commit before the ADR cites it.

Disclosed residuals, unchanged and non-gating. Re-observed by me: K6c resets of inherited-ignored SIGQUIT/SIGTERM/SIGWINCH and the SIGPIPE ignore (harness observation, both OSes); duplicate delivery of terminal SIGINT/SIGWINCH/SIGHUP in shared layouts (2 per event, K6b-allowed and documented); no NOTICE/third-party attribution shipped; darwin artifact ad-hoc signed only, not notarized; Windows compile-only. Not re-run by me: SIGKILL orphan, closed fd 1, PID-reuse window, the 1 s mutex hold when a stop is discarded, the stale-SIGCONT window, Bubble Tea goroutine panics exiting 2. Those stand on REPORT.md and the earlier reviews.

refuted_claims.claim: Stage summary: 'Non-gating K6b observations: terminal-generated SIGINT was delivered twice in 4/10 trials on darwin (duplicates observable) and 0/10 on linux.'
refuted_claims.evidence: tests/g02/conformance.py check harness.signal_duplicate_probe builds observations.signal_duplicates from DOUBLE_FORWARDER, a Python wrapper that sends each signal twice with kill(). heimdall-proto is not involved. My independent terminal ^C through heimdall-proto (probes/sigjob-*.json 'ctrl_c'): exclusive 1/1/1, stdin-from-file 1/1/1, pipeline 2, wrapper script 2/2/2, identical on darwin and linux under bash, zsh and dash.
